snippet.title: Midnight Mayhem - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Midnight Mayhem, a first-person horror online co-op game developed by Gradient Games. Players will gather in teams of five to take on a powerful invisible enemy in an asymmetrical fashion. As the invisible enemy evolves with more abilities over time, the human team must use precise communication and strategy to emerge victorious. Midnight Mayhem is launching on June 3 for PC (Steam).

#Gaming #Games
